svg.title: Lab 01 — One flat LAN
svg.desc: 192.168.1.0/24 · no router, no default gateway · the switch forwards frames straight between hosts by MAC
svg.text: 192.168.1.0/24 · no router, no default gateway · the switch forwards frames straight between hosts by MAC
Server0 answers; switch learns both MACs
no router, no gateway, no IP routing
Switch the Packet Tracer view to Simulation and filter ARP, ICMP, HTTP: watch the broadcast flood, then unicast forwarding.
Same subnet means no gateway is needed: hosts ARP for each other directly.
